context.working_title: NATS JetStream for Go Developers: A Production Guide
context.business_outcome: Build topical authority in high-performance Go backend engineering and capture senior developer traffic.
context.audience: Senior Go backend engineers and software architects migrating from Kafka or RabbitMQ.

topical_authority.information_gain: Real-world Go production benchmarks (e.g., 100k RPS) comparing NATS JetStream to Kafka, specifically tailored for the Go ecosystem with practical code implementations and architectural trade-offs.

keywords.cannibalization_check: No existing vesviet posts target 'nats jetstream golang' as a primary keyword. It was only mentioned as an alternative in Alipay and Core Banking series.
keywords.serp_notes: Top results usually focus on basic NATS pub/sub. Few deep dives into JetStream persistence and consumer patterns using Go.

geo_aeo.answer_first_block: NATS JetStream là một event streaming engine siêu nhẹ và hiệu năng cao được viết bằng Go, thường được sử dụng làm giải pháp thay thế Kafka nhờ khả năng cung cấp persistence, Exactly-Once delivery và kiến trúc multi-tenant mà không cần ZooKeeper hay JVM.
